items.name: knowns-icons
items.title: Knowns UI icons
items.description: Provider logos from a model name, brand logos or glyphs from a tool name, and actorIcon().

items.name: motion
items.title: Motion
items.description: Shared motion for state changes: duration and easing tokens, and helpers for a status icon that draws, shakes or pulses, a fold, rows that slide in and collapse out, a number that counts and a value that flashes. Reduced motion is instant.

items.name: knowns-core
items.title: Knowns UI core
items.description: cn() helper, Actor/Span/Task/Approval types, the event-fed run store (createAgentRun, useAgentRun) and shared state labels and colours.

.kn-scroll-fade-x.mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, #000 var(--kn-fade-inset-l, 0px), transparent var(--kn-fade-inset-l, 0px), #000 calc(var(--kn-fade-inset-l, 0px) + var(--kn-fade-l)), #000 calc(100% - var(--kn-fade-r)), transparent), linear-gradient(#000, #000)

items.name: social
items.title: Social links
items.description: socialOf(href): the platform of a link (Discord, X, GitHub, LinkedIn and more) from its URL, with a label and one-style icon. Used by Team Grid, Team List, Team Showcase and Site Footer.

items.name: knowns-field
items.title: Field look
items.description: The shared look of text fields: hairline ring, soft focus ring and a red ring when invalid. Used by Input, Textarea, Select and Combobox.

items.name: knowns-floating
items.title: Floating position
items.description: useFloating(): portal host, fixed positioning, flip and clamp for tooltips, popovers, menus and comboboxes.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: A stack of collapsible sections. One open, or several, with a full keyboard path.

items.name: agent-cursors
items.title: Agent cursors
items.description: Agents editing a document like multiplayer teammates: coloured live pointers with name, action and spend, suggestions typed in as tracked changes with accept, reject and Accept all, image resize, code edits, margin comments with a typing indicator, and a Table tab.

items.name: agent-fleet
items.title: Agent fleet
items.description: Many agents at a glance: a row (or card) per main agent with model, task, state, spend and clock, totals on top, and a sub-agent tree that unfolds under it with approve and retry right in it.

items.name: agent-graph
items.title: Agent graph
items.description: Live graph of agents and the tools they call: tree, horizontal and center layouts, light streaks per call, detail popover.

items.name: agent-handoff
items.title: Agent handoff
items.description: A relay of agents: who handed what to whom, with the context passed along, lost items, a light along the rail on each new hand-off, and forward reassignment by drag or keyboard.

items.name: agent-lanes
items.title: Agent lanes
items.description: Where every agent is right now: a lane per agent, tasks growing into now, hand-offs and approvals on the block.

items.name: agent-monitor
items.title: Agent monitor
items.description: One agent at work as a card: current step with a clock and cost, a time strip, finished steps with tool logos, the exact command when it needs your OK, and a folded bar.

items.name: agent-plan
items.title: Agent plan
items.description: The steps an agent intends to take, checked off live: step states, sub-steps, elapsed times, a progress bar, animated plan changes, Approve plan / Edit plan and a one-line collapsed view. Reads the run store or plain props.

items.name: ai-answer
items.title: AI answer
items.description: Streamed answer with steps, sources, numbered citations that preview their source, copy, regenerate, feedback and follow-ups.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: An inline callout with info, success, warning and error tones, an optional title, one action and a dismiss button.

items.name: animated-number
items.title: Animated number
items.description: A number whose changed digits roll up or down to the new value: Intl formatting for currency, percent and decimals, tabular widths, instant with reduced motion.

items.name: approval-prompt
items.title: Approval prompt
items.description: Requests waiting for a human decision with a preview and Approve / Deny.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Image, logo or initials with status dot, badge and verified mark; AvatarGroup with +N and invite; AvatarLabel with name and supporting text.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Status labels in six tones: sizes, pill shape, icons, clickable and removable badges, and BadgeGroup with +N overflow.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App Shell
items.description: The frame of a signed-in app: a sidebar with a workspace switcher, nav, pinned groups and a footer slot that folds to an icon rail (Cmd or Ctrl+B), and a sticky topbar with breadcrumb, search, notifications and the account menu. A modal sheet on mobile.

items.name: activity-feed
items.title: Activity feed
items.description: A timeline of what people and agents did: unread dots and Mark all read, type tabs with counts, expandable rows, day groups and a live N new update pill.

items.name: notification-center
items.title: Notification center
items.description: A bell with an unread count and a panel of notifications: tabs, day groups, read state, agent actions and an endless list; a sheet on phones.

items.name: auth-card
items.title: Auth card
items.description: Sign in or sign up by email code, magic link or both, with OAuth buttons (GitHub, Google, Microsoft, Apple or your own), resend and rate-limit countdowns. Callbacks only, any auth backend.

items.name: auth-page
items.title: Auth page
items.description: The page around the auth card: centered, or split with a brand panel that takes any background.

items.name: aurora
items.title: Aurora
items.description: Up to three soft colour fields drifting slowly behind your content. Transform-only CSS, no blur filter.

items.name: backgrounds-core
items.title: Backgrounds core
items.description: Shared shell and helpers for the backgrounds: fade masks, theme-token colours, density and speed, seeded layouts, and the motion gate.

items.name: cube-field
items.title: Cube Field
items.description: A field of small shaded cubes that rise and settle under the pointer, with a slow idle wave, flat isometric or tilted in perspective with glowing crests. Canvas, redrawn only while cubes move.

items.name: dither-field
items.title: Dither Field
items.description: A soft light rendered as crisp ordered-dither dots: a glow that eases after the pointer, a rising horizon or flowing noise. Canvas, redrawn only while the light changes.

items.name: dot-spotlight
items.title: Dot Spotlight
items.description: A quiet dot grid with a soft light that follows the pointer and lifts the dots under it. CSS only.

items.name: flickering-grid
items.title: Flickering Grid
items.description: Small squares that flicker toward a low ceiling, a few at a time, with an optional word glowing out of the grid. Canvas, repainting only the squares that change.

items.name: gradient-floor
items.title: Gradient Floor
items.description: A lit floor that rises from the bottom edge: two soft gradient layers drift and breathe, and pulse(x) sends a wave across it from a ref or from other pieces (Prompt Keyboard sends one per key). CSS and the Web Animations API, no blur filter, no per-frame JavaScript.

items.name: grid-pattern
items.title: Grid Pattern
items.description: A crisp hairline grid with a few lit cells that trade places now and then. One SVG pattern on whole pixels, with dashes, tilt and a fade mask.

items.name: node-field
items.title: Node Field
items.description: Drifting nodes that link with hairlines when close; the pointer joins as a node. Canvas, drawn only while visible.

items.name: perspective-grid
items.title: Perspective Grid
items.description: A grid floor running toward the viewer and fading into a soft horizon. One looping CSS 3D transform.

items.name: signal-lines
items.title: Signal Lines
items.description: Faint routed traces with pulses travelling along them, like agent traffic. Seeded SVG with dashoffset pulses.

items.name: catalog-grid
items.title: Catalog grid
items.description: A catalogue page: category tabs with counts over a grid of thumbnail cards with New and Pro badges, plus a Sketch kit for quiet monochrome thumbnails in one visual language.

items.name: conversation-list
items.title: Conversation list
items.description: A chat history list: a search box, pinned chats, groups by day, inline rename and a row menu for pin, rename and delete. Arrow keys move between rows; F2 renames, Delete asks to delete.

items.name: cookie-consent
items.title: Cookie consent
items.description: A consent banner with Accept all, Reject all and Customize, and a preferences dialog with categories (necessary locked on). Saves the choice, calls back, never blocks the page, and rejecting is as easy as accepting.

items.name: blog-grid
items.title: Blog grid
items.description: A blog index: a featured post and a grid of cards with cover, tags, title, excerpt, author, date and reading time, tag filter chips, Load more or pages, and an empty state.

items.name: blog-post
items.title: Blog post
items.description: A blog post page: header, article typography, a sticky table of contents that follows the reader, a reading-progress bar, Copy link and share, previous / next and related posts.

items.name: changelog-feed
items.title: Changelog feed
items.description: Dated version entries tagged New / Improved / Fixed / Breaking with rich content, media and links, a tag filter, an RSS link, and a compact What's new list with unread dots.

items.name: content-core
items.title: Content core
items.description: Shared pieces for the content blocks: article typography and content blocks (headings, lists, quotes, code, callouts, images, tables), covers, author chips, and helpers for reading time, table of contents, reading progress, filters, highlighted matches and a small search.

items.name: search-results
items.title: Search results
items.description: A search results page: query box, result count and timing, type facets with counts, highlighted matches with breadcrumbs, keyboard moves, suggestions when nothing matches, and pages.

items.name: docs-install
items.title: Docs install
items.description: Installation with CLI and Manual tabs: a shadcn add command per package manager, and numbered manual steps (dependencies, registry items, each file with its target) on a rail with callouts.

items.name: docs-layout
items.title: Docs layout
items.description: Docs layout composing the docs blocks: optional sidebar, a reading or wide content column, a right rail, previous / next cards and a Need help card.

items.name: docs-page-header
items.title: Docs page header
items.description: Docs page header: breadcrumb, title, lead, a Copy page split button with a menu of more actions, and previous / next arrows.

items.name: docs-preview
items.title: Docs preview
items.description: Preview / Code card with a toolbar: phone, tablet and full widths, zoom, a preview-only theme, Replay and Full screen, plus a named-example heading with a badge slot.

items.name: docs-toc
items.title: Docs table of contents
items.description: Right rail with a nested, scroll-aware On this page list, optional links (e.g. Contribute) and cards, and a floating pill below xl.

items.name: error-pages
items.title: Error Pages
items.description: 404 with search and popular links, 500 with retry, a status link and a copyable error ID, and Maintenance with a live ETA and a notify-me form. Each takes an illustration.

items.name: contact-section
items.title: Contact section
items.description: Contact methods beside a form with name, email, topic and message: labelled fields, errors that clear as they are fixed, focus on the first problem, a callback, and a same-height thank-you panel.

items.name: cta-section
items.title: CTA section
items.description: Closing call to action: headline, lead, one or two buttons or an email capture with validation, busy, error and thank-you states, on a plain, accent or inverted panel or over a background. Centred or split layout.

items.name: faq-section
items.title: FAQ section
items.description: Questions in an accordion with topic chips, accent-insensitive search, copyable #question-id deep links that open on load and hash change, and a Still have questions card. Stacked or split layout.

items.name: feature-grid
items.title: Feature grid
items.description: Features in 3 or 4 columns with icon, title, text and an optional link, plus a bento variant with wide, tall and large cards that can hold a picture or a live component.

items.name: hero
items.title: Hero
items.description: Landing page hero, centred: eyebrow chip, rotating headline word, two CTAs, an install command chip, optional facts row and a background slot. align="start" for a left-aligned version. Reduced motion keeps it still. Pro variants: hero-split, hero-product, hero-statement.

items.name: logo-cloud
items.title: Logo cloud
items.description: A grid of logos, grey until hover or focus, with light and dark variants and a wordmark fallback when there is no logo.

items.name: marketing-2b-core
items.title: Marketing 2b core
items.description: Pure helpers for Testimonials, FAQ Section, Newsletter, Contact Section and Team Grid: email and contact validation, FAQ filter, ids and hash links, carousel steps and the auto-advance gate, masonry columns, rating labels.

items.name: newsletter
items.title: Newsletter
items.description: Email sign-up as an inline band or a compact card: address check, busy state, returned or thrown errors, and a confirmation in the same space. A side offer, separate from the CTA section's capture.

items.name: marketing-core
items.title: Marketing core
items.description: Shared pieces for the marketing sections: section heading, action buttons and arrow links, a fixed-aspect media frame (lazy image, dark variant, click-to-load video, live content), and pure helpers for tilt, marquee timing, bento spans and row sides.

items.name: stats-band
items.title: Stats band
items.description: Three or four headline numbers that count up on view, with labels, detail lines, an optional proof visual per number (trend, daily bars, distribution), a context line on hover or focus and a source footnote. Plain, card or divided tone; reduced motion shows final values.

items.name: team-grid
items.title: Team grid
items.description: The people behind the product as cards or compact tiles: photo or initials, name, role, location, a clamped bio that opens in place, and labelled social links. The list layout is a Pro variant that builds on it.

items.name: testimonials
items.title: Testimonials
items.description: Customer quotes as a masonry grid with highlighted quotes: name, role, company, avatar or initials and an optional star rating. The carousel and large-quote layouts are Pro variants that build on it.

items.name: onboarding-checklist
items.title: Onboarding checklist
items.description: First-run steps for a dashboard corner: progress, done, current and locked states, a call to action and an optional how-to on each step, snooze and dismiss, and a calm completion state.

items.name: settings-api-keys
items.title: API keys settings
items.description: API keys with live or test environments, idle detection, inline create that shows the secret once, expandable details and hold to revoke.

items.name: settings-billing
items.title: Billing settings
items.description: Current plan with status and renewal, usage meters, payment method, invoices, and cancel or resume with confirmation.

items.name: settings-layout
items.title: Settings layout
items.description: Settings page layout with a responsive section nav, titled sections, label-control rows, a save bar with unsaved-change tracking and a danger zone.

items.name: settings-license-key
items.title: Settings: license key
items.description: License keys that can be shown again, with copy, regenerate behind a confirm, status and dates, and a usage meter.

items.name: settings-notifications
items.title: Notification settings
items.description: Events by channel (email, push, in-app) with row and column toggles, required events, an email digest and quiet hours.

items.name: settings-profile
items.title: Profile settings
items.description: Avatar upload, name, username, email change and bio with Save/Discard, and account deletion behind a typed confirmation.

items.name: settings-security
items.title: Settings: security
items.description: Connected logins (connect, disconnect) and active sessions (this device marked, sign out one or all others). Callbacks only.

items.name: settings-team
items.title: Team settings
items.description: Invite by email with a role, change roles, remove or leave, pending invites; protects the last owner and your own role.

items.name: setup-wizard
items.title: Setup wizard
items.description: A multi-step setup on the Stepper: per-step validation, Back, Next and Skip, a review step, a final success state, focus to the step heading and optional URL sync. Works in a page or a dialog.

items.name: sidebar-docs
items.title: Docs sidebar
items.description: A docs sidebar built on Sidebar: search, filter chips, sections, categories and pages with counts, New and Pro marks, upcoming pages marked Soon, remembered folds and the current page scrolled into view.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: An app sidebar: a nav tree with full keyboard, an icon rail or a fully hidden mode that remembers its state with Cmd or Ctrl+B, flyouts for branches, search, a workspace switcher, and a modal sheet on mobile.

items.name: announcement-bar
items.title: Announcement bar
items.description: Dismissible announcement bar above the header: a link or CTA, an optional countdown, tone variants, dismissal remembered per id in localStorage, and a smooth height collapse with no layout jump.

items.name: site-footer
items.title: Site footer
items.description: Site footer with brand and blurb, 3 to 5 link columns (accordions on phones), a newsletter mini-form with a callback, social links, a status line, a theme switch and the legal row.

items.name: site-header
items.title: Site header
items.description: Sticky site header with a blur and hairline on scroll, links, dropdowns and a mega panel with a featured card, active indicator, search trigger, theme toggle, account or Sign in, and CTA. Includes a mobile drawer: a modal dialog with accordion groups and scroll lock. Marketing and minimal variants.

items.name: template-app-dashboard
items.title: App dashboard
items.description: A signed-in dashboard on the App Shell: sidebar with workspaces, topbar with search and notifications, page header, stat band, a fleet of agents that need you, recent activity and a usage card. Demo data, replace it with yours.

items.name: template-docs-site
items.title: Docs site
items.description: A docs site in one component: a home with search and category cards, then pages with the docs sidebar, page header, install steps, callouts, table of contents and previous/next links. Demo pages for a fictional product, replace them.

items.name: template-saas-landing
items.title: SaaS landing page
items.description: A whole landing page from the marketing blocks: announcement bar, header, hero on a dither field, logo cloud, features, stats, pricing, testimonials, FAQ, call to action and footer. Demo brand and copy, replace them.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Path of links that collapses middle items into an overflow menu.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Primary, secondary, ghost and destructive buttons with icons, three sizes and a loading state that stays focusable.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid: single day, range or multiple days, one or two months, min/max and disabled days, controlled paging, a renderDay slot for dots and badges, full keyboard navigation. Intl only, no date library.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Bordered surface with header, content and footer parts.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Line, bar (grouped or stacked), area and sparkline in plain SVG with no dependency: axes, grid, keyboard tooltip, legend toggles, empty state and a screen-reader data table.

items.name: chat-composer
items.title: Chat composer
items.description: Agent input: autosizing text, attachments, model and permission-mode menus, connected apps, working folder, dictation, send and stop.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Native checkbox with label, description, indeterminate state and sizes; CheckboxGroup with select-all.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: Code with syntax colours, a copy button, filename and language label, line numbers, highlighted lines, a wrap toggle and long-output collapse. No highlighter dependency, and a slot for Shiki.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Select with icons, avatars, status dots, supporting text, groups, search, multiple choice and a tags mode. Opens as a popover, a dialog, or a bottom sheet on phones.

items.name: command-menu
items.title: Command menu
items.description: ⌘K palette: fuzzy search with highlights, groups, shortcuts, nested pages, recents and async results - all by keyboard.

items.name: context-window
items.title: Context window
items.description: How full a model context is and what fills it: segmented token bar or cell field, thresholds in words, per-part files you can remove, compact action, ring variant and per-turn sparkline.

items.name: custom-cursor
items.title: Custom Cursor
items.description: Draws the pointer inside an area as an arrow with a name pill, a dot that grows into a label over data-cursor-label targets, or a crosshair with coordinates. It follows with a light spring. It stays off on touch and coarse pointers and under reduced motion, and keeps the native cursor over inputs and data-cursor="native"|"hidden".

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: A real <table> with multi-sort, filters and search, range selection, column visibility, density, pagination or virtualised rows.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date picker
items.description: One date, optionally with a time: a typeable field that reads ISO, locale-ordered numbers, month names, today/tomorrow, 'next fri', 'in 3 days' and '3pm', with a live preview and a calendar popover; or a button or an inline panel. Quick picks, min/max, disabled days, Intl only.

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: Date range picker
items.description: Range or single date in a popover: one or two month calendar, presets, keyboard grid navigation, min/max and disabled days, Field label/hint/error. Intl only, no date library.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Modal on the native dialog element.

items.name: dropdown
items.title: Dropdown
items.description: Ready-made menus on Menu: account, row actions and pickers with avatar, toggle, link and badge rows.

items.name: fan-stack
items.title: Fan Stack
items.description: A stack of cards that fans out on hover or keyboard focus and restacks on leave or blur. A tap toggles it on touch. Each card rotates around a point below the stack, with a short stagger. Card content is a slot; spread angle and gap are props. Transform-only, no motion on first render, instant under reduced motion.

items.name: file-drop
items.title: File drop
items.description: Drop zone with type/size/count validation and FileItem rows with progress, retry and remove.

items.name: ghost-text
items.title: Ghost text
items.description: Inline AI completion for an input or textarea: a faint suggestion after the caret, Tab to accept, Ctrl/Cmd+Right for one word, Esc to dismiss, a loading shimmer and a screen reader hint. Plain and monospace variants.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover card
items.description: A preview card that opens when the pointer rests on a link or focus lands on it: open and close delays, the card stays open while you move into it, and on touch a first tap opens it and a second follows the link.

items.name: empty-states
items.title: Empty states
items.description: Quiet animated scenes for no runs, an empty inbox, no tools and no agents, with title, description and action.

items.name: illustrations-core
items.title: Illustrations core
items.description: Shared helpers for illustrations: pause offscreen, in hidden tabs and under reduced motion.

items.name: model-orbit
items.title: Model orbit
items.description: Model logos orbiting an agent hub, with the active model linked and a smooth hand-over between models.

items.name: model-reel
items.title: Model reel
items.description: Model logos and names drifting in a calm marquee, one or two rows.

items.name: prompt-to-team
items.title: Prompt to team
items.description: A prompt types itself and branches into a team of agents with roles, models and tools.

items.name: run-pulse
items.title: Run pulse
items.description: A small living agent graph for heroes: streaks from lead to agents to tools, nodes that grow in.

items.name: tab-overload
items.title: Tab overload
items.description: A small stack of overlapping browser windows for a 4:3 feature or bento card. The highlight follows the window under the pointer and, when nobody is hovering, drifts on its own. Quiet, theme-aware, still under reduced motion.

items.name: tool-beam
items.title: Tool beam
items.description: Your product between the tools it connects, with data flowing along curved beams; hover to focus, click to pause.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Input with sizes, prefix/suffix, shortcut and password reveal; InputGroup; Textarea with counter and auto-grow; Field with label, hint, error, required and help.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Keyboard key.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: Dropdown menu for a button: sections, checkable items, descriptions, icons, typeahead and arrow-key navigation.

items.name: message-actions
items.title: Message actions
items.description: The quiet action bar under an assistant message: Copy that turns into a check, Regenerate with a version switcher, thumbs up and down with a short reason picker, Read aloud with a live equalizer, and an overflow menu.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP input
items.description: One-time code in N slots: paste fills all, auto-advance and backspace, numeric or alphanumeric, masked, error state, onComplete.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Pages with ellipsis, previous/next, page size select and a compact variant.

items.name: parallax-card
items.title: Parallax Card
items.description: A card that leans away from the pointer: the surface shifts a few px and grows to 102% while its content and an optional edge-bleeding media move further, for depth. Plain, muted or accent ground with optional grain. Transform-only with one rAF while hovered; still on touch and with reduced motion.

items.name: password-field
items.title: Password field
items.description: Password input with a show/hide toggle (aria-pressed, controllable), a Caps Lock warning, autocomplete for sign-in or a new password, and Field integration.

items.name: password-strength
items.title: Password strength
items.description: Segmented strength meter with a text label, a live configurable rules checklist, a generate-and-copy strong password button and polite announcements. Exports pure scorePassword, passwordRules, checkPassword and generatePassword helpers.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Floating panel that closes on Escape or an outside click and returns focus.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Progress bar and ring, determinate or indeterminate.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: One choice from a few options; arrow keys move and select; card variant.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable panels
items.description: Split panels with draggable, keyboard-operable handles, min and max sizes, collapsible panels and sizes saved between visits.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented control
items.description: Mutually exclusive options with a sliding thumb.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Native select in the field style, with sizes, a leading icon and a placeholder.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Thin divider.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel that slides in from any edge on the native dialog element: focus trap, Escape, scroll lock, and a bottom drawer you drag down to dismiss.

items.name: shine-border
items.title: Shine Border
items.description: A sheen that travels around an element's border, for the one thing a view most wants chosen. CSS only: an @property angle turns a conic-gradient masked to the border ring. Continuous, hover or once modes; pauses offscreen; still gradient border with reduced motion or without @property.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Loading placeholder. Every skeleton on a page shares ONE light sweep, like a single light passing over the layout. Content-shaped presets (text, profile card, list, media grid) and a gate that crossfades into the real content without shifting the layout.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Single value or range slider with steps, marks, a value bubble and full keyboard support.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Small indeterminate spinner.

items.name: status-dot
items.title: Status dot
items.description: Coloured dot for idle, busy, blocked, failed and finished; live states pulse.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Horizontal or vertical steps with done, current, upcoming and error states, optional descriptions and clickable completed steps.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: On/off toggle with role=switch.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs in underline, pill and button styles, horizontal or vertical, with icons, counts, overflow scrolling and a sliding indicator.

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: Quiet chips and TagGroup with selection, removal and roving focus.

items.name: decode-text
items.title: Decode text
items.description: Text that resolves out of noise into its final value, without layout shift.

items.name: gradient-text
items.title: Gradient text
items.description: Text filled with a slowly flowing gradient, with an optional matching gradient-border pill.

items.name: number-ticker
items.title: Number ticker
items.description: Digits that roll to the new value, for costs, tokens and live metrics.

items.name: shimmer-text
items.title: Shimmer text
items.description: A soft bright band sweeping through in-progress labels like Thinking…

items.name: text-animation-core
items.title: Text animation core
items.description: Shared pieces for text animations: accessible shell, motion gate, caret.

items.name: token-stream
items.title: Token stream
items.description: Text arriving token by token with a caret, like a model's reply; or follow a real stream.

items.name: typewriter
items.title: Typewriter
items.description: Types, makes a mistake, deletes and retypes; or cycles phrases.

items.name: word-rotate
items.title: Word rotate
items.description: One word in a headline that changes in place, keeping its width.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line field that grows with its text up to a row limit, with a character or word counter, a soft or hard limit, and a counter that is announced only when it matters.

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: Theme toggle
items.description: Light/dark (or light/dark/system) toggle that reveals the new theme with a View Transition: a circle from the click point (the button centre for keyboard), a wipe, or a fade. Sun-to-moon icon morph. Instant without View Transitions or under reduced motion. Controlled or uncontrolled (localStorage + .dark on html), SSR-safe, with themeScript() for no flash and transitionTheme() for menus.

items.name: thinking-indicator
items.title: Thinking indicator
items.description: A one-line working indicator: a small glyph (dot grid wave, node chain pulse, filling ring or breathing bars), a shimmering status label and an optional elapsed timer.

items.name: thinking-state
items.title: Thinking state
items.description: What an agent is doing before it answers: live steps, searched sources, tool calls, streaming reasoning and a 'Thought for 12s' summary.

items.name: time-slots
items.title: Time slots
items.description: The times of one day to pick from, for booking: shown in a chosen time zone with its label, disabled slots, keyboard list navigation and an inline Confirm. Intl only, no date library.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Notifications with ToastProvider and useToast().

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle group
items.description: Pressable toggles, alone or in a toolbar group: single or multiple, attached or spaced, horizontal or vertical.

items.name: tool-call-card
items.title: Tool call card
items.description: One call in detail: status and duration, input, output or error as highlighted JSON, retry.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Short hint on hover or focus, four sides, optional description; portaled above everything.

items.name: trace-waterfall
items.title: Trace waterfall
items.description: Every call of a run on one time axis: nested by caller, live bars, inline input/output/error, filters, search, brush zoom, critical path and virtualised rows.

items.name: uptime-bar
items.title: Uptime bar
items.description: One row of day bars for one service: up, degraded, down or no data, with the uptime percent, a tooltip on hover or focus, one tab stop with Left, Right, Home and End to inspect days, Enter to select one, and a screen reader summary worked out from the data. Bars thin out on a narrow container, never a horizontal scroll.

items.name: user-menu
items.title: User menu
items.description: Account menu behind an avatar: identity header with plan badge, account rows with shortcut hints, theme and status switches, async sign out, and a bottom sheet on phones.
